note: A single site on an open clearing beside Bonnell Run Road, a forest road reached from Lower Pine Bottom Road (off PA 44 or PA 664) by Bull Run Road, about 2.9 miles to the turn. The agency cautions: 'Road to campsite is rough and not recommended for low-clearance vehicles.' The driveway is shared with a tent-only site, BR 002, about 30 m away. No table, fire ring, toilet or water is listed. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: BR 001 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, 'Trailer Site' category only, max vehicle and equipment length 35 ft, pull-in gravel driveway 60 ft, grades Slight, clearance 15 ft; count 1 and 35 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-off): a bare open clearing about 25 x 20 m on the north side of the forest road, open sky, the pin on it. NHD: Bonnell Run (intermittent) 99 m away through woods; not waterfront.
flags: ACCESS WARNING for the owner's call (kept, as p3-368 kept the same wording): site page 'Caution: Road to campsite is rough and not recommended for low-clearance vehicles.' DCNR GIS notes: 'Road to site is rough - not recommended for low clearance vehicles.' It is a recommendation against low-clearance vehicles, not a high-clearance or 4WD requirement; grades are 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight'. The stored note's 'high clearance advised' is replaced by the agency's own sentence. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
EQUIPMENT (rulings 4 and 8, reported not raised): the page lists 'Looking For Category: Trailer Site' with no 'RV Site' category; Max Vehicle Length 35, Site Access Drive-In. Kept.

Shared driveway: 'Driveway Shared: Y'. The DCNR GIS layer has BR 002 32 m from BR 001: 'Added for RA system. Tent only. Stone ring.', TrailerAccess No. BR 002 is not part of this entry and should not be.
Water: NHD has Bonnell Run (intermittent) 99 m from the site, woods between; nothing else within 200 m. Not waterfront, no lead.
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own number and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: BR 001, Bonnell Run Road'); nothing to change.

Equestrian/ATV check: the Tiadaghton horseback page names no horse camp; the ATV page names only the Haneyville ATV Trail (trailhead on SR 44 on its brochure map). The 2024 ATV Regional Trail Connector Pilot map linked from the advisories page answered 404 and is UNREAD.

Tiadaghton advisories page (read 2026-11-10): Brown's Run and Sinking Springs Roads closed to snowmobiles with a detour (2024-2025 season); 'Stay alert for ATVs' (ATV pilot uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory for the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail; Dividing Line Trail closed indefinitely; e-bike rules. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice on this entry's road. The Tiadaghton camping page publishes no seasonal closure, hunting-season rule or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.'
